name: codex-claude-orchestrator
description: Coordinate Codex, native subagents, and Claude CLI as a parallel software team with constraints, contract alignment, checkpoints, handoffs, regression gates, and reviewed merges.

interface.shortDescription: Open a live control plane for parallel Codex and Claude teams
interface.longDescription: Open a live React control plane where Codex coordinates native subagents and Claude CLI across parallel responsibilities. The plugin captures shared and per-agent constraints, contract alignment, file reservations, checkpoints, handoffs, regression gates, validation, review, and explicit merge decisions.
defaultPrompt: Open the team control plane to plan Codex, native subagent, Claude, and contract-alignment responsibilities.
Start parallel Codex and Claude work with per-agent constraints, file boundaries, checkpoints, and safe handoffs.
Open the control plane to review Running, Blocked, Ready, validation, regression, and merge status.
